code:
def build_ghz_circuit(n_qubits):
  """...
  Qubit roles:
    Qubit 0 is control for every CX.
  Expected measurement distribution:
    Only '0'*n and '1'*n, ~50% each.
  Validated against:
    qiskit 1.2.4, qiskit-aer 0.15.1.
    Not yet validated on real
    hardware -- see roadmap.md.
  """
caption: The honest "not yet validated" line — overstating coverage would be exactly what Lesson 4 warned against.

code:
# examples/run_ghz_demo.py
qc = build_ghz_circuit(n_qubits=3)
backend = LocalSimulatorBackend(
  seed=42)
counts = backend.run(qc, shots=1024)
z = (k/1024-0.5)/sqrt(.5*.5/1024)
print("PASS" if abs(z)<2.58 else
  "FAIL", "(99% confidence)")
caption: Prints the z-score and the explicit threshold — a new user learns not just the verdict but the standard it was judged against.
